body:
## Goal
Provide a dependency-free HTTP server that answers GET / with a 200 text/html "Hello, World!" response, launchable via npm start.

## Spec
Add a single ESM source file `server.js` at the repo root using only Node's built-in `node:http` module — no Express, Fastify, Koa, or any other web framework, and no new runtime dependencies. The server MUST bind to the port from `process.env.PORT`, defaulting to `3000` when the variable is unset or empty. A `GET` request to path `/` MUST return HTTP status `200`, a `Content-Type` header of `text/html`, and a response body that contains the exact substring `Hello, World!`. The response contract for other methods/paths is left to the deliverer (a 404 for unknown paths is reasonable) and is not load-bearing. `package.json` already exists (`mandrel-bench-target`, `"type": "module"`); amend it by adding a `"start"` script that launches the server with `node server.js` — do not remove the existing `typecheck`/`lint`/`test` scripts and do not introduce dependencies. Keep the implementation to exactly the one new source file plus the amended `package.json`.

## Changes
- `server.js` — creates
- `package.json` — refactors-existing

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: A single new source file `server.js` exists at the repo root and imports only Node built-ins (`node:http`); no external web framework or new dependency appears in package.json
- [ ] AC-2: Starting the server with no PORT set binds to port 3000; when PORT is set to a value it binds to that port instead
- [ ] AC-3: A GET request to `/` returns HTTP status 200 with a `Content-Type` header of `text/html` and a response body containing the exact text `Hello, World!`
- [ ] AC-4: `package.json` has a `start` script that launches the server (`node server.js`), and the existing typecheck/lint/test scripts remain intact

## Verify
- PORT=3100 node server.js & SRV=$!; sleep 1; curl -si http://localhost:3100/ | tee /tmp/hw.out | grep -qi '^HTTP/1.1 200' && grep -qi '^Content-Type: text/html' /tmp/hw.out && grep -q 'Hello, World!' /tmp/hw.out; RC=$?; kill $SRV; exit $RC (validate)
- node --check server.js (validate)

## Non-Goals
- No external web framework or added npm dependencies
- No routing beyond GET / (other paths/methods are unconstrained)
- No TLS/HTTPS, logging framework, or config system
